primaryTextChecks.text: After that, the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, and in the South, and in the lowland.

context.text: The children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, took it, struck it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.

primaryTextChecks.text: She said to him, “Give me a blessing; because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” Then Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

context.text: When she came, she got him to ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey; and Caleb said to her, “What would you like?”

The children of the Kenite, Moses’ brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and lived with the people.

Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.
